probeLimits: Low-probe retains timestamps and native step/backlog reads; it is not probe-free production.
Instrumented CPU spans are inclusive; step is inside advance. GPU is asynchronous and must not be added to CPU.
Frozen timestamps measure a fixed simulation, not natural gameplay. Native windows evolve; following instrumented windows are not matched-state probe overhead comparisons.
Pending tail GPU queries are counted and excluded. Upload totals cover Float32 texSubImage2D and typed bufferSubData, not all WebGL transfers.
Diagnostic freeze/play resets debt between windows; before/after live debt and discarded deltas are captured before that reset.
Fresh headless Chrome profiles; no CPU/GPU throttling requested. Not physical-input/human/thermal-control or full-content acceptance.
